text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Today's mock race... was truly wonderful. 
Everyone giving it their all, clashing 
with all their might—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Everyone baring their instincts, devouring 
one another... Ah... just watching it 
makes me—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! Oh no... I'm doing it again—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Nngh...! Be rational... keep your 
composure... Don't... don't come out...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
This is bad... After a race, I really need 
to find a place where I can be alone...
